_doc: P0.5 — audited registry of every canonical VFS write exemption. Each exemption reason must map to an approved category, and every file's per-reason count is frozen here. Adding an exemption requires an explicit, reviewed entry.

categories.hydration: Loads already-persisted bytes (revision, draft, sealed snapshot, wizard handoff) into an empty or stale working set. Creates no new site state.
categories.adoption: Projects the authoritative result of an accepted commitMutation / declared adoption record into the working set. The commit already happened.
categories.rollback: Restores a previously captured working set after a refused or failed transaction.
categories.local-history: Editor or AI-history undo / redo / revert / reapply of a working-set snapshot the user already had.
categories.router-projection: Deterministic re-projection of /src/App.tsx (or a registry-owned page deletion) from the canonical PageRegistry. The registry, not the writer, is the authority.
categories.workspace-import: Developer-workspace import of external code, a saved project or a scraped page into the editor buffer before any commit.
categories.editor-buffer: Editor working-buffer projection; persistence happens on the next commit.
categories.runtime-manifest: Non-content runtime plumbing (dependency manifest, canonical Unison runtime files).
categories.optimistic-hmr: Optimistic preview projection that MUST be chained to a commitMutation / saveDraft in the same code path. Highest-risk category — guarded by a proximity check.
